description: This is a modern CoreDNS dashboard for your Kubernetes cluster(s). Made for kube-prometheus-stack and take advantage of the latest Grafana features. GitHub repository: https://github.com/dotdc/grafana-dashboards-kubernetes

targets.expr: container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} * on(namespace, pod) group_left(instance) up{cluster="$cluster", job="coredns", instance=~"$instance"}
rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(instance) up{cluster="$cluster", job="coredns", instance=~"$instance"}
container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} * on(namespace, pod) group_left(instance) up{cluster="$cluster", job="coredns", instance=~"$instance"}

title: Kubernetes / System / CoreDNS
